revenue_scope: Amryt's 'Lomitapide' row of its revenue-by-product table (Juxtapid in the U.S. and other markets, Lojuxta in the EU): global lomitapide revenues in the table's own columns U.S., EMEA and Other, summing to the Total column, in US$ thousands. Q1 2020 comes from a Form F-1 table that prints the Total only.
why_separate: Aegerion's gold series (2013Q1-2016Q3) is global net product sales of Juxtapid. Amryt's line is also global and includes the EMEA sales Novelion did not book, but it is printed by a different issuer after a break (Novelion's last report is for 2019Q1 and Amryt completed the Aegerion acquisition on 2019-09-24), so it is a successor_issuer continuation, not part of the series, and not joined to the Novelion continuation, whose scope excludes EU product sales.
series_start_reason: First full quarter in which Amryt owned Aegerion: the U.S. business joined on 2019-09-24, so 2019Q3 (6,705 thousand; nine months 2019 15,598 less six months 8,893, with U.S. 1,319 for about one week) carries only a few days of U.S. sales and is not a comparable quarter. Q1 and Q2 2019 are Amryt's EMEA-only Lojuxta sales (4,419 and 4,474).
series_end_reason: Amryt's last results release is Q3 2022 (6-K 0001171843-22-007045, 2022-11-03). Its EDGAR filings after that (6-Ks of 2023-01-03, 2023-01-09, 2023-02-16, 2023-03-23, 2023-04-03 and 2023-04-12) are scheme and acquisition documents and print no lomitapide revenue; no 20-F for 2022 was filed.
notes: Quarters 2019Q4-2022Q3 are contiguous. Annual checks: 2020 quarters 17,421+18,052+19,113+20,164 = 74,750 (printed FY 2020 total); 2021 quarters 18,184+19,450+18,538+17,695 = 73,867 (printed FY 2021 total in the 20-F 0001140361-22-016877). The FY 2020 release states FY 2019 lomitapide revenues of $68.0M on a pro forma basis that includes Aegerion for the full year; it is not used. 2019Q4 is read from the prior-year table of the FY 2020 release and 2020Q1 from the Form F-1, because no Amryt release for those quarters is on EDGAR; both are labelled accordingly. Amryt was acquired by Chiesi (scheme completed April 2023); Q4 2022 and later are not printed on EDGAR.
search_log: Amryt Pharma plc (CIK 1783010) filing list read via data.sec.gov (recent filings, no older-file pages): F-1 (2020-06-23, 2021-01-08), F-4, 20-F (2021-04-30, 2022-04-29) and 6-Ks from 2020-07 to 2023-04. Every .htm exhibit of those filings was fetched and searched for table rows labelled Lomitapide, Juxtapid or Lojuxta.

Q3 2019 and earlier: the Q3 2020 release prints Q3 2019 as 1,319 | 5,143 | 243 | 6,705 and the Q2 2020 release prints Q2 2019 as 4,474 (EMEA only); not entered because the U.S. line only joined on 2019-09-24.

Q4 2022: 6-Ks of 2023-01-03, 2023-01-09, 2023-02-16, 2023-03-23, 2023-04-03 and 2023-04-12 searched for lomitapide revenue lines: none. Web search for an Amryt FY 2022 results release returned only the Q2 2022 and Q3 2022 releases.
Not checked: Amryt's own investor site, which may hold FY 2019 and FY 2022 documents that are not on EDGAR.
